comments.author: alice
comments.body: The first version did `httpx.post(...)` inline in the service. All outbound calls go through a client module built on `make_client` (ADR-006), which gives you the timeouts, retries and request ids for free. See `app/clients/card_network.py` for the pattern.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: This raised `HTTPException(404)`. Services raise `app.errors` domain errors and the API layer maps them (#117). This function runs from the dispute consumer, where an HTTPException means nothing.

comments.author: erin
comments.body: Fair. At my last job the services were only ever called from routes, so HTTPException everywhere was normal. Switched to errors.NotFound.

comments.author: bob
comments.body: Makes sense, here they're also called from consumers and jobs.
